title: Mercury feature tabs
description: Half-and-half feature section: a calm heading over a list of rows split by hairlines, the open row marked by a bright rule and a small pale-blue dot with its text and an underlined link. A tall rounded picture (art or mock UI) fills the other half and changes with the row; on phones it sits inside the open row.
notes: click a row to open it; without JavaScript the first row stays open
set mediaSide to start to put the picture on the left (alternate it down the page)
